issues.reason: Historical frozen score lookup omitted drug; scores from different drugs overwrote the same model/seed/genome key. Historical frozen metrics and paired comparisons are not valid ranking evidence.
issues.evidence: Original 20261112 run used _frozen_scores without drug key (subsequently fixed); correctly drug-filtered ciprofloxacin ensemble on 620 samples: Bacformer AUROC 0.916420515574651, AP 0.8257621812680037; ESM AUROC 0.6265887934121017, AP 0.520028771733032.

note: 从保存的聚合表读取，不重跑模型；不同数据集、统计口径与任务不得合并排名。
